what: An SVG blob (amoeba shape) wobbles slowly through three shapes over 15 seconds — a smooth closed curve of eight points built from a seed number, in SMIL <animate> switches to straight connected lines. Used as is for background color blobs, menu button backgrounds, the white plate behind photos and the video clip-path window (objectBoundingBox). Each blob’s begin is delayed by 1s so they stagger

options.seed: Type seed count, default 1 — same count gives the same Type
options.begin: Delay (s), default 0 — the original background blocks use 0 · 1 · 2 · 3
options.box: Cell to fill the shape “width height” — default is the viewBox of the wrapping svg. Required inside a clipPath (objectBoundingBox)
options.static: If true, a single static shape (footer background mass)

use: <svg viewBox="0 0 906 547"><path data-fx="svg-blob-morph" data-fx-svg-blob-morph="seed: 11; begin: 1" style="fill: var(--kf-accent)"/></svg>

from.where: index.html four background blobs (begin 0 · 1 · 2 · 3s) · menu button base (white .4) · white panel behind the campus illustration · video clip-path window (#kg-clip-movie, box: 980 600) · white panel behind the anniversary section logo — the original cycles three hand-drawn shapes with SMIL 15s indefinite (keySplines are present but calcMode is missing, so lines stay straight)

note: The original paths are not carried over, and shapes are built from a seed, so outlines differ. Length, repetition, curve (straight lines) and delay are as in the original
